Hi Rishi,

We need to lock down the invoicing cadence and drawdown windows for our annual prepay (signed SOW, DEAL-8743). Finance asked for: 1) a proposed tapping schedule (how committed credits will be drawn against the prepay across the 12 months), 2) the billing/legal entity you will invoice, and 3) VAT evidence for the US / international routing.

Can you share a proposed schedule and any documents we should attach to our PO? Also please confirm whether we can get consolidated quarterly invoices or if you’ll need monthly invoices for ledger reasons.

Thanks — want to get this into our AP system by Oct 20.

Best,

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is our proposed tapping schedule and the VAT evidence we have for the US billing flow. High level:

- Proposed cadence: monthly tapping by default with the option to consolidate to quarterly on your side (we’ll still record monthly drawdowns for telemetry).
- Typical tranche size: we split the annual prepay into 12 equal tranches for predictability; we can shift to a bi-monthly or quarterly pull if you prefer.
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference US, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) — invoice to be issued to the legal name shown on the SOW unless you route via a different entity.
- VAT / tax: US domestic billing is VAT-exempt; for any EMEA entities we’ll provide VAT registration evidence and the VAT-attested invoice template.

Next steps I propose: 1) confirm whether AP wants monthly invoices or consolidated quarterly invoices, 2) share PO number and remit details, 3) we’ll issue a draft invoice schedule and an amendment for the payment cadence if needed.

I attached: RI_Annual_Tapping_Schedule_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) and VAT_Evidence_US.pdf (stub).

If useful, Kim from billing is on this thread to confirm routing and DocuSign amendment details.

Thanks,
